scripts.radio:
Good evening listeners, welcome back to Kenya on Record. Today, we need to have a very candid conversation about the police recruitment drives happening across our counties.

Every year, a familiar and painful story plays out in our villages. Parents sell their last piece of land, families take high-interest loans, and households sell off livestock to raise money for a broker who promises a "guaranteed slot" in the National Police Service. 

Let us be crystal clear: by law, police recruitment in Kenya is 100% free. There is no such thing as a reserved slot for a middleman, a politician, or a senior official to sell. Anyone who approaches you asking for fifty thousand, one hundred thousand, or two hundred thousand shillings to secure a job for your son or daughter is a fraudster. 

When you pay a broker, you are not buying a career; you are simply handing over your family's inheritance to a thief. If your young person meets the physical and academic standards, let them try at the recruitment center openly. If they do not, no amount of bribe money will safely or legally put them in uniform.

Kwa ufupi: Usajili wa polisi ni bure kabisa kisheria. Mtu yeyote anayekuomba pesa au kukushawishi uuze shamba au mifugo ili upate nafasi ya kazi ni tapeli. Usitoe rushwa, na usiuze mali ya familia. Ukipata matapeli hawa, waripoti kwa polisi mara moja.
scripts.voice_note: Habari zenu. Quick head-up from Kenya on Record for everyone preparing for the upcoming police recruitment. Please, do not fall for the brokers moving around our villages right now. The law is very clear: police recruitment is entirely free. Anyone asking you for money, or convincing you to sell a piece of land or your cows to buy a job slot, is scamming you. Nobody has reserved slots in their pocket. If someone asks for a bribe to get your child into the police service, that is extortion, not help. Protect your family's land and hard-earned savings. Pass this message to your family and village groups today—usiibiwe.
scripts.sms: Usiibiwe: Police recruitment is 100% free by law. Selling land or paying brokers for a job slot is a scam. Don't sell your assets. Report extortion.
scripts.reels: Every year, families sell land and drain savings to buy a police recruitment slot. Here is the truth: police recruitment in Kenya is free by law. Anyone asking for money to "secure a slot" for your child is a thief. There are no secret slots for brokers. Don't sell your family's future for a lie. Report extortion immediately.
